page_title: SEV 1-0 PAL | Sevilla v Las Palmas 13/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+13' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
90+12' Loic Bade (Sevilla) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card. Las Palmas have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
90+10' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) hits a piledriver from long range, but the effort curls well wide of the right post.
90+8' Suso (Sevilla) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
90+6' The cross into the penalty area from Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
90+5' It's like he was asking for a caution. Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) receives a yellow card.
90+5' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla).
90+4' The game is interrupted. Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
90+3' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
90+1' Leandro Antonetti (Sevilla) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Dinko Horkas makes a comfortable save.
90' The fourth official shows 12 min. of added time.
90' Juan Martinez interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Saul Niguez (Sevilla). It's a free kick to Las Palmas in a dangerous position.
87' Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Juan Martinez lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
85' Having seen unsporting behavior, Juan Martinez shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Jose Campana (Las Palmas) is the recipient.
85' Suso (Sevilla) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
83' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) is given a yellow card.
82' Diego Martinez decides to make a substitution. Viti will be replaced by Marvin (Las Palmas).
82' Substitution. Alberto Moleiro makes way for Jaime Mata (Las Palmas).
79' The attendance is 37078.
79' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
78' Goal disallowed! Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) scores but Juan Martinez blows his whistle for a foul.
76' The referee is firm and issues Saul Niguez (Sevilla) a deserved yellow card.
76' Joaquin Caparros Camino has decided to substitute Djibril Sow and he is replaced by Saul Niguez (Sevilla).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Leandro Antonetti is coming onto the pitch as Alvaro Pascual (Sevilla) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
72' The game is interrupted now, Alvaro Pascual (Sevilla) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
71' Half-chance! Viti (Las Palmas) plays a pass into the box, but Orjan Nyland reacts well to snuff out the attack.
70' A substitution has been made. Adnan Januzaj is replaced by Marc Cardona (Las Palmas).
70' Diego Martinez prepares a substitution. Jose Campana is replaced by Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas).
70' Alex Suarez goes off the pitch and Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) comes on.
69' The resulting free kick from Suso (Sevilla) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
69' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. A free kick is awarded to Sevilla.
66' The resulting set piece from Las Palmas is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
64' Sevilla failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

63' Suso (Sevilla) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity. The ball is out of play. Sevilla will have a chance to score from a corner.
62' Suso (Sevilla) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
60' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) nicely brought down the pass, but his long-range effort was wild and went well wide of the right post.
59' Albert Sambi Lokonga is substituted due to injury. Joaquin Caparros Camino gives a chance to Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla).
59' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
58' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Juan Martinez blows his whistle for a foul. Las Palmas have a free kick.
56' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
55' Suso (Sevilla) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
54' The corner is swung in but Sevilla can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
54' Surely that's handball by one of the Las Palmas players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
52' 1 - 0 GOAL 1:0! The resulting free kick is headed powerfully goalwards by Lucien Agoume and Alvaro Pascual (Sevilla) glances a header from close range into the back of the net.
51' Diego Martinez is forced to make a change. Stefan Bajcetic is unable to continue due to injury, Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) comes on.
51' Stefan Bajcetic (Las Palmas) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
50' Juan Martinez blows the whistle, Stefan Bajcetic (Las Palmas) is penalised for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Sevilla.
49' Sevilla work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
49' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The linesman points to the corner flag, Sevilla are going to take it.
47' Alvaro Pascual (Sevilla) commits a rough challenge and Juan Martinez blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Joaquin Caparros Camino is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Kike Salas suffers an injury and Ramon Martinez (Sevilla) comes on.
43' Kike Salas (Sevilla) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
40' The ball is laid off to Jose Campana (Las Palmas) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom left corner and forces Orjan Nyland to make a decent save.
39' Suso (Sevilla) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Juan Martinez blows his whistle for an infringement.
38' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post.
37' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
36' Orjan Nyland is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Viti (Las Palmas). Easy save!
35' The ball rebounds to Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) and he shoots from distance, but the keeper calmly watches it drift well wide of the right post.
33' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Dinko Horkas is alert and denies him.

31' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Juan Martinez with no other option than to blow for a foul.

27' What a chance that is! Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post.
26' Sevilla can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
25' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
24' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card. Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) will miss the next game.
24' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
22' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
20' Juan Martinez blows his whistle after Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
17' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Orjan Nyland, who smothers the ball.

14' Orjan Nyland makes a brilliant save! Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the bottom right corner but is saved by the keeper!
14' A lofted cross from Suso (Sevilla) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
11' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
9' Juan Martinez blows his whistle as Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
7' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
6' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
5' Suso (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but Dinko Horkas comes off his line to gather the ball.
4' Foul! Alvaro Pascual (Sevilla) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
2' A cross from a corner kick by Las Palmas is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
